findings.value: Centro de Coordenação Operacional Nacional (CCON) (National Operational Coordination Centre)
findings.title: Aviso
findings.publisher: Autoridade Nacional de Emergência e Proteção Civil (ANEPC)
findings.note: ANEPC issues the SMS warnings, which mobile operators then deliver on its request.

review.reason: At national level, CCON decides when civil protection warnings are issued. That is a decision role and the quote does not say CCON operates the systems.

findings.question: Electricity grid control: Transmission system operator control and market systems (SCADA/EMS)
findings.quote: Enquanto gestor técnico global do Sistema Elétrico Nacional, a REN - Rede Elétrica Nacional é a entidade responsável pela segurança e continuidade do serviço de eletricidade, com o seu centro de Despacho a assegurar permanentemente o equilíbrio entre a produção e o consumo de energia elétrica.
findings.quote_english: As overall technical manager of the National Electricity System, REN - Rede Elétrica Nacional is responsible for the security and continuity of the electricity service, with its Dispatch centre permanently ensuring the balance between production and consumption of electricity.
findings.value: centro de Despacho (National Dispatch centre) of REN - Rede Elétrica Nacional
findings.title: Eletricidade
findings.publisher: REN - Redes Energéticas Nacionais
findings.note: The operator's own site; REN runs the transmission grid under a concession from the Portuguese state. The quote also supports REN - Rede Elétrica Nacional as operator.

review.reason: REN is the overall technical manager of the national electricity system and runs the dispatch centre that balances supply and demand. SCADA and EMS are not named.

findings.question: Water management control: Flood defence, water board and drinking-water control systems
findings.quote: O Sistema Nacional de Informação de Recursos Hídricos (SNIRH) processa, valida e divulga toda a informação recolhida nas redes de monitorização da APA
findings.quote_english: The National Water Resources Information System (SNIRH) processes, validates and publishes all information collected by the APA monitoring networks
findings.value: Sistema Nacional de Informação de Recursos Hídricos (SNIRH) (National Water Resources Information System)
findings.title: Sistema Nacional de Informação de Recursos Hídricos - SNIRH
findings.publisher: Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente (APA)
findings.note: This is a monitoring and information system that also assesses droughts and floods, not a SCADA control system.

review.reason: SNIRH processes and publishes data from APA's monitoring networks. The quote does not state who operates SNIRH, and it covers monitoring data, not flood-defence or drinking-water control systems.
